title: Improving compatibility in mixed-matrix membranes - Nature Energy
text:
Mixed-matrix membranes promise to combine the processability of polymers with the transport advantages of porous fillers, yet poor compatibility between the two limits their performance. New research shows that tailoring interfaces between polymers and covalent organic frameworks enables high filler loadings, producing improved membranes for carbon capture.
